source.name: Electricity Authority generation investment pipeline
source.publication_method: Monthly dashboard populated from Transpower clause 2.16 investment-pipeline submissions
source.do_not_use_as_current_source: The downloadable EMI generation-investment CSV files are 2024 snapshots and must not be treated as the current pipeline.

status_definitions.committed: Final investment decision has been made.
status_definitions.actively_pursued: No final investment decision yet, but significant development milestones have been reached.

committed_only.description: Conservative supply case. Include only projects reported as committed.

committed_plus_active.description: Central development case. Include committed and actively pursued projects.

full_pipeline.description: Upper-bound development case. Include committed, actively pursued and other projects. This is not a forecast that all projects will be built.

commissioning.unknown_date_policy: exclude from dated adequacy run until a commissioning assumption is explicitly supplied

technology_treatment.solar: weather-dependent generation profile scaled by project MW
technology_treatment.wind: weather-dependent generation profile scaled by project MW
technology_treatment.geothermal: firm generation with explicit availability/outage assumption
technology_treatment.hydro: add plant and water constraints explicitly; never model as unconstrained firm energy
technology_treatment.battery: model MW and MWh separately with round-trip efficiency and state of charge
technology_treatment.thermal: dispatchable generation with fuel and availability constraints

notes: Project status is scenario selection, not a probability of completion.
The Electricity Authority cautions that not every pipeline project will be built.
Pipeline capacity must not be compared directly with demand energy without applying technology-specific generation profiles and commissioning dates.
